ui_steps: Data > Pick fields on this page opened the Matrx Field Picker overlay on the actual book tab.
Clicked the page margin outside the book's child blocks, selecting the full html document. The Data panel displayed field_1: html.
Named and saved the unique pattern, then clicked Extract. Data showed EXTRACTED ROWS (1).
Used Data > Copy rows > JSON, For AI agent, and TSV. Each product action displayed Copied; the clipboard was read immediately after the corresponding copy.
Showcase > Patterns displayed the same saved pattern. Run pattern showed LAST RUN and 1 ROW in Result Preview. Used Copy JSON, Copy for AI, and Copy TSV; each action displayed Copied.
Refreshed the actual Gutenberg tab, returned to Data, clicked Extract for the persisted matching pattern, and copied JSON again.

new_candidate_defect.title: Showcase Copy for AI omits advertised source URL

new_candidate_defect.actual: The copied preamble starts 'The following is extracted rows from a webpage.' then '- Row count: 1' and the JSON fence. It contains no source URL, despite the result coming from the live Gutenberg tab.
new_candidate_defect.scope: Observed in Showcase Result Preview only; Data's For AI agent copy did include the source URL.
